scoring_justification: Recompute complex impedance from reported S11 and verify against published physical thresholds for angle-independent/dependent absorption.

hidden_assets.purpose: Thresholds and reference values for impedance and reflectance for four perfect absorber designs.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper figures and text: Z_real ≈ 1, Z_imag ≈ 0 for matched designs; Z_imag ≈ -0.2 for mismatched; reflectance thresholds from angular dispersion analysis.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from the paper's impedance matching model and numerical simulation results (Figures 3, 5 and discussion).
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values represent the physical impedance matching condition required for angle-independent absorption as derived in the paper.

outputs.description: CSV file containing the resonance wavelength, complex impedance, and angle-resolved reflectance for the four absorber designs. The checker recomputes impedance from S11 internally and verifies that the values meet the physical thresholds consistent with angle-independent or angle-dependent behavior.

output_contract.notes: The disordered single-element design (compiled from the FDTD simulation) may leave reflectance angles empty; only Z_real and Z_imag are required for that row. The solving agent should use the provided geometries and public material data to run RCWA and FDTD simulations, then extract the quantities. The checker will confirm internal consistency of impedance and apply hidden threshold-based scoring.
